sn19.12:1.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ purisaṃ gūthakūpe nimuggaṃ ubhohi hatthehi gūtham khādantaṃ || || 2
sn19.12:1.2: Eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva Rājagahe brāhmaṇo ahosi ||
sn19.12:1.3: so Kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimantetvā doṇiyā gūthassa pūrāpetvā etad avoca || ||
sn19.12:1.4: Aho bhonto yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjantu ceva harantu cāti || ||
